note: Bootstrap artifact for harness-execution-redesign-2026-08 Task 1 (Stage 0a, invariant 2: 'cadence >= 2x measured cycle time for every recurring mechanism, doctor-enforced'). This is the FIRST version of the aggregate artifact the 2026-08-02 considerations brief names as missing (process-chain blind spot 4: 'no aggregate artifact... the layer that ate 90% of the machine is the one layer that grew review-free'). Stage 1 (nl-maintenance.sh) replaces the six per-machine scheduled tasks this manifest currently describes with completion-anchored internal jobs and becomes the manifest's real-time writer; until then this file is hand-maintained and doctor-enforced WARN-only (calibration week per the task-1 spec -- flips to RED in a later task, not this one).

cadence_check.ratio_floor_meaning: declared_cadence_seconds must be >= ratio_floor x measured_cycle_seconds for every entry that has a non-null measured_cycle_seconds. Entries with measured_cycle_seconds == null are calibration-pending and are skipped (not WARNed) -- absence of a measurement is not itself a violation at this stage.
